lines.name: SLICK
lines.text: You're staring at that pie like it owes you money.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Long year, by the look of you. Spreadsheets?

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: For a guy who signs his name on them.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: And what did you want? Before the lanyard.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: Poker. For real. I know how that sounds at two in the morning.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: At two in the morning, it's the only true thing anybody says in here.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: envelope
lines.text: Biscayne Card Room. Saturday, noon. The seat's paid.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: Why would you do that for a stranger?

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Because I sat on that stool once. Somebody bought my pie.

lines.name: SLICK
lines.subject: slick
lines.text: Three things. Fold the junk. Lean on the scared ones. And near the money, play the money, not the chips.

lines.name: CARD
lines.subject: note
lines.text: Inside, one line in pen: "People insist on calling it luck."

directions.text: rain on the window, the neon buzz, the pie case hum; a booth radio low
he slides a red envelope along the counter; the chrome catches the neon
he leaves cash for both checks; the bell over the door rings; you look down at the envelope
